manaNeeded: {10}{U}{U}{U}{U} the first turn with {9}{U}{U}{U} each other turn
notablePrerequisites: You control at least two Doctors.
easyPrerequisites: You've cast exactly one spell this turn.
description:
Cast Twice Upon a Time by paying its mana cost.
Taigam triggers, copying Twice Upon a Time and exiling the original Twice Upon a Time with four time counters on it.
Resolve the Twice Upon a Time copy, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Cast Clockspinning with buyback by paying {3}{U}, removing a time counter from Twice Upon a Time and returning Clockspinning to your hand.
Repeat step 4 one additional time.
Move to your next turn. At the beginning of your upkeep, Twice Upon a Time's suspend ability triggers, removing a time counter from it.
Cast Clockspinning with buyback by paying {3}{U}, removing a time counter from Twice Upon a Time and returning Clockspinning to your hand.
Twice Upon a Time's suspend ability triggers, causing you to cast it from exile without paying its mana cost.
Repeat from step 2.
